title: Momcozy Video Baby Monitor, 5" 1080P HD Baby Monitor with Camera and Audio
bullets: 【You Deserve Peace not Guesswork】- Momcozy baby monitor will always watch out for your baby. Through the 1080p HD camera & 5'' large display, you just feel like you are right there.Whether at work, housework, sports or leisure, you only need to look at the screen for peace of mind.【Momcozy baby monitor is a recipient of the prestigious Mom’s Choice Award.】

【Easy Setup and Hassle-free Operation】- All you need to do is plug in the camera and turn on the monitor to connect instantly, no pairing required, and it's ready to use, saving you the hassle of viewing a lot of text.

【Rest Assured throughout the Night】- You'll be able to view clearly with the infrared night vision even it's pitch-dark. Even better, it can last all night thanks to the 5000mAh rechargeable battery.Even with the most frequent checks, the battery life can be as long as 11.5 hours, so you don't have to worry about missing your baby's news.

【Never Miss a Single Spot】- 360 degrees field of view allows a panoramic vision of your little one. You shall never miss a single spot of the room.With its own split screen and loop playback functions, the monitor will automatically loop between two views, allowing you to fully cover the environment and enjoy a movie-like viewing experience.

【Show up Timely for Your Baby】- When your baby gets fussy or lets out a cry, you will hear instantly and the screen will automatically light up when VOX is on. So you can be there when you're really needed.In front of the baby, whether it is playing a lullaby or talking to the baby through the screen, it gives a great sense of security to comfort the baby.
